resources.string: Pause all hiding and redirects while this is off.
Choose what FocusTube hides in YouTube and supported mobile browsers. Your settings stay on this device.
Enable FocusTube in Accessibility settings so it can recognize YouTube and browser screens and apply your choices.
Leave Shorts and open the regular video instead.
Cover Shorts tabs and Shorts shelves in the YouTube app.
Cover the YouTube home feed or open Subscriptions in a browser.
Hide Shorts in search and channel pages
Cover Shorts shelves and rows outside the Home feed too.
Set daily hours when FocusTube should apply your settings. Times use your device’s local time.
Outside these hours, FocusTube is paused automatically.
Please review how FocusTube uses Android Accessibility before continuing.

FocusTube uses the AccessibilityService API to read on-screen content only in YouTube and selected browsers (Chrome, Brave, Microsoft Edge, Samsung Internet, Firefox, Opera, and Vivaldi) to detect and hide Shorts and the YouTube home feed. No on-screen content is stored, logged, or sent anywhere. Your settings are saved only on this device.
Choose Agree to continue to Android Accessibility settings. No thanks closes FocusTube without opening those settings.

FocusTube collects no personal data. Screen content is inspected locally and only while the accessibility service is enabled; it is used to hide Shorts and the home feed or to follow your selected feed mode. No on-screen content is stored, logged, or sent. The app has no INTERNET permission, analytics, advertising, or tracking SDKs. Feature choices, schedule times, disclosure acceptance, and a temporary pause time are stored locally in private app preferences. FocusTube opts out of Android app backup. Settings are removed when you clear app storage or uninstall FocusTube.\n\nFor privacy questions, use the Contact developer link on the FocusTube Google Play listing.

To stop the service, open Android Accessibility settings, choose FocusTube, then turn the service off. You can also turn off the FocusTube is on switch in the app to pause its actions.\n\nTo remove the app, open App info below and choose Uninstall. Turning off or uninstalling FocusTube does not affect YouTube or your browser.

Hides Shorts and the YouTube home feed in YouTube, Chrome, Brave, Microsoft Edge, Samsung Internet, Firefox, Opera, and Vivaldi. On-screen content is read locally only for these features and is never stored, logged, or sent.
